summary: Implemented internal/health with RegisterRoutes(mux) registering GET /health, returning a JSON {"status":"ok"} body, and 405 for any other method.

files_changed.description: RegisterRoutes(mux *http.ServeMux) registers a handler on /health that checks r.Method == http.MethodGet, writes Content-Type: application/json and body {"status":"ok"} on GET, and calls http.Error with 405 for any other method.
Table-driven test covering GET (expects 200 + JSON body) and POST (expects 405), using httptest.NewRecorder against a mux built via RegisterRoutes.
